project_detail.title: Intelligent Cart State Detection
project_detail.description: A real-time video analytics system for detecting and tracking the state of shopping carts using advanced computer vision techniques and optimized sampling strategies.
project_detail.overview_p1: This project demonstrates an intelligent video analytics system for real-time detection and tracking of shopping cart states in retail environments. The system employs advanced computer vision algorithms and optimized video frame sampling techniques to efficiently analyze cart occupancy levels.
project_detail.overview_p2: By leveraging state-of-the-art object detection models like YOLOv8 and robust tracking algorithms, the system can reliably monitor multiple carts simultaneously, even in challenging real-world scenarios. The customizable region of interest (ROI) feature allows for focused analysis in specific areas of the video frame.
project_detail.overview_p3: The system provides detailed analytics and intuitive visualizations, enabling store managers to gain valuable insights into customer behavior and optimize store operations. With its cross-platform compatibility and scalable architecture, the solution can be easily integrated into existing retail systems.

challenges.title: Optimizing Sampling Rate
challenges.description: Fine-tuned the video frame sampling rate to achieve an optimal balance between processing speed and analysis accuracy.

challenges.title: Tracking Multiple Carts
challenges.description: Implemented robust object tracking algorithms to reliably follow multiple shopping carts simultaneously.

challenges.title: Real-time Performance
challenges.description: Optimized the system architecture and algorithms to enable smooth real-time cart state detection and analysis.

project_detail.system_states_intro: This project was developed to automate the seed and product filling process in an industrial setting. The system monitors carts as they move through different stages from empty to full and uses computer vision to track, analyze, and optimize the filling process.

states.name: Empty Platform
states.description: The platform is ready, waiting for a cart to be placed for the filling process to begin.

states.name: Empty Cart
states.description: A cart with 6 empty slots is positioned on the platform, ready to receive test tubes.

states.name: Incomplete Cart
states.description: The cart contains between 1 and 5 test tubes, indicating the filling process is underway.

states.name: Complete Cart
states.description: All 6 slots are filled with test tubes. The cart is ready for sealing and quality analysis.

project_detail.process_explanation: Once filled, tubes are sealed and pass through the detection model to capture metrics such as processing duration, identify potential issues, and analyze system behavior for continuous improvement.

model_limitations.title: Model Evolution & Limitations
model_limitations.intro: In this section, you can observe a comparison of the training process, the selected hyperparameters, and the false positives generated throughout the model's development, allowing us to visualize how the model has evolved based on the training it received.
model_limitations.dataset_text: During the project, the conveyor belt used to capture the images was damaged, preventing the collection of additional data. As a result, the model was trained on only
model_limitations.dataset_suffix: which is considerably small for a computer vision task.
model_limitations.potential_text: Despite these constraints, the system demonstrates promising capabilities, and its performance could improve significantly with a larger and more diverse dataset.

crps_detail.title: CRPS - Real-Time Facial Recognition System
crps_detail.description: A comprehensive real-time facial recognition system that combines advanced computer vision techniques and vector databases to efficiently identify and search for faces in surveillance, access control, and user authentication scenarios.
crps_detail.overview_p1: This project implements a cutting-edge facial recognition system that addresses the challenges of fast and accurate face identification in real-world scenarios. The system handles various factors such as different facial angles, occlusions, varying lighting conditions, and the need to match faces against a large dataset of known identities.
crps_detail.overview_p2: The solution combines state-of-the-art techniques: YuNet for precise face detection even in challenging conditions, FaceNet for generating robust facial embeddings invariant to pose and lighting, and Weaviate as a vector database optimized for similarity search. This architecture ensures both accuracy and efficiency in real-time operations.
crps_detail.overview_p3: With an intuitive PyQt graphical interface, encrypted data storage for security, and multi-threaded processing for real-time performance, the system provides a comprehensive solution suitable for surveillance systems, access control, and user authentication applications.
features: Graphical user interface built with PyQt

face_antispoofing_detail.title: Face Anti-Spoofing System
face_antispoofing_detail.description: An AI-powered solution to prevent identity falsification by detecting presentation attacks in facial recognition systems with high accuracy and real-time performance.
face_antispoofing_detail.overview_p1: This project addresses the critical security challenge of presentation attacks in facial recognition systems. Using deep learning techniques, the system can distinguish between genuine faces and various types of spoofing attempts.

face_antispoofing_detail.overview_p3: Extensive testing with various attack types ensures robust protection against evolving spoofing techniques.
features: High accuracy with low false positive rate
